patch_description: Redesigned the program to use explicit Pareto-style filtering for candidate paths. For each server, we generate 3 trees using different latency/energy/capacity blends. When reconstructing paths for a source, we evaluate them and keep only the best path (minimizing a combined metric) plus at most one alternate path that offers a materially different tradeoff (e.g., >5% lower latency or energy). This ensures a compact, diverse candidate set. The assignment phase uses a mathematically exact marginal cost formulation for both latency (queueing delay derivative) and energy, followed by a regret-based greedy initialization and local search refinement.
